$comment: Storm mode (issue #23). capHours: the longest horizon safe hours are quoted for. stableGridMinutes: minutes of grid back before the storm ends (plan §9.2). minIntervalMinutes: one family message per transition and person within this interval. The EPS load besides the safe-room split is the home profile's epsBaseLoadW (#19). occupantGainW: sensible heat of a resting adult in the safe room. inApp.maxPerHome: how many of the phone's messages are listed (they are kept in the StateStore with its own retention).
